items.text: Theorem (any type). With equality of values decided and both types inhabited, a family is complete exactly where all values are equal. Completing it step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns.

home_old: **Theorem** (any type). Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap; so no family of claims says every reading, and no frame realizes with its own configurations every pattern of claims about them. With equality of values decided and both types inhabited, a family is complete, saying every function on the indexed domain, exactly where all values are equal. Completing it step by step, each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap, is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns (not everything a later step says was said at an earlier one); with likeness transitive no two gaps are alike, and with it symmetric too no finite stock holds them. The liar is a rhythm with no still value. Lean: `Diagonal.gap_unsaid`, `Diagonal.complete_iff_alike`, `Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns`; [record](../results/records/readings-within-what-they-read.md). Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.
